run_AlphaFold_prediction: run the AlphaFold model to predict protein structure from feature arrays using RunModel.predict
init_AlphaFold_params: initialize AlphaFold model parameters randomly from feature dict using RunModel.init_params
process_AlphaFold_features: process raw feature arrays into model-ready input using RunModel.process_features
eval_AlphaFold_output_shape: evaluate the output shape of the AlphaFold model without running inference using RunModel.eval_shape
compute_confidence_metrics: compute pLDDT, pTM, and ipTM confidence metrics from prediction results using get_confidence_metrics
